note: Illustrative registry. ACTIVE means implemented in at least one source path; it does not guarantee that the current Home widget renders it. See 01_REPO_AUDIT.md.

rules.triggerSummary: Configured limit near/over threshold or actual derived jar balance below zero; keep limit pressure distinct from balance shortage.
blockedWhen: not current month where rule requires current month
rules.resolveWhen: The rule no longer fires or the relevant state has been corrected; dismissal alone is not resolution.

rules.triggerSummary: Prototype baseline: spend > 1.3 × prior period and delta >= 500000 VND; validate comparable elapsed windows.
rules.resolveWhen: Spike no longer meets the rule or a newer comparable period replaces the candidate.

rules.triggerSummary: Known positive minimum payment, valid Vietnam-local date, due in 0-30 calendar days; urgent within 7 days.
blockedWhen: full-statement amount asserted without statement data
rules.resolveWhen: Due event is completed/overdue according to reliable payment status, or no longer in the configured horizon.

rules.triggerSummary: Summarize detected recurring expenses; a distinct new subscription/price increase requires an additional rule and comparison evidence.
rules.resolveWhen: No longer supported by the recurring detector or the observation window expires.

rules.triggerSummary: Emit once per newly observed posted refund, if refund classification and category/jar impact are reliable.
rules.resolveWhen: Event has been shown/expired; do not represent it as a recurring risk.

rules.triggerSummary: A new posted income event exists and a safe pool remains after obligations/reserves.
rules.resolveWhen: Income event is no longer recent or pool was allocated/changed materially.

rules.triggerSummary: Deterministic forecast projects available CASA below zero or approved reserve floor.
blockedWhen: confirmed and estimated obligations merged without labels
rules.resolveWhen: Recomputed forecast no longer breaches the threshold or relevant obligation is paid/cancelled.

rules.triggerSummary: Valid deposit matures in the configured lead window.
rules.resolveWhen: Maturity date passed or the product record/status changed.

rules.triggerSummary: Cash stays above the protected reserve floor throughout the full 90-day observation period.
rules.resolveWhen: Amount drops below reserve/threshold or the time window is no longer satisfied.

rules.triggerSummary: A closed period has material leftover under the actual jar ledger/rollover semantics.
rules.resolveWhen: User reviews/allocates it or a newer closed period replaces it.

rules.triggerSummary: Emit only if existing conservative reserve, debt, goal and spend checks all pass.
rules.resolveWhen: Safe surplus no longer meets policy or underlying reserve inputs change.
